_doc: The app (site/, gegenprobe.app) under `make claims` (src/gegenprobe/claims_app.py): site/ holds the app's own files and a core.json whose `bound` numbers equal what the committed results give; every `bound` value is bound to the claim it states (bindings: key, claim, fmt optional) or listed under `unbound`; every number the app writes itself (index.html, 404.html, app.js string literals) and, where Chrome is found, every number in the rendered data-claims blocks of the routes under `rendered` is the value of a bound claim or inside an `allow` phrase. Per-affair data (rows, per-parliament counts, filtered counts) is outside this check; its sums are checked against the bound totals.

bindings.why: interventions with a recorded government answer (Lookup, About)
the parliaments' attached counts sum to it
proposed repairs (Lookup, About); the queue holds exactly these rows
Repair queue: Bern relinks after the hash decision
Repair queue: fetch from the parliaments

allow.why: example query: an affair number (per-affair data)
example query: an OPD id (per-affair data)
the HTTP status of the not-found page

About, schema verdict: the two body-specific constructs (oral answers, councils that publish only minutes); bound by the wording pin schema.body_specific_constructs (claims_pins.json: len(schema.body_specific) in results/evidence/data.json is 2), which pins this phrase in app.js; the field count before it is bound.body_specific
